q: Logging Service 基础需求包含哪些点？（多选）
q_en: Which base requirements does the Logging Service need? (Select all)
options: 五个级别 DEBUG < INFO < WARN < ERROR < FATAL
每条记录包含 timestamp、level、message、threadName
每个 destination 有自己的 minLevel 和 formatter
并发写同一 destination 时字节不能交错
why: 题目重点是同步日志库的核心模型和并发写安全。异步、热更新、远程目的地和层级 logger 是后续扩展。
why_en: The base logger has ordered levels, immutable records, per-destination thresholds and formats, and non-interleaved concurrent writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 五值有序枚举 DEBUG<INFO<WARN<ERROR<FATAL，用于记录严重度和 destination 的阈值比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LogLevel is the five-value ordered enum from DEBUG to FATAL used for severity and threshold comparisons.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 destination 自己配置的最低级别阈值，记录级别低于它就被静默丢弃。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: minLevel is the per-destination threshold below which a record is silently dropped.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

termDefinitions.meaning: 产生这条日志的线程名，在 Logger.log 顶部随 timestamp 一起只捕获一次。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: threadName is the emitting thread's name, captured once at the top of Logger.log alongside the timestamp.

options_en: Five ordered levels: DEBUG below INFO below WARN below ERROR below FATAL.
Every record carries a timestamp, level, message, and thread name.
Each destination has its own minimum level and formatter.
Concurrent writes to the same destination must never interleave bytes.
optionExplanations: 有序级别防止候选人漏掉阈值比较的基础——没有顺序就无法判断哪些消息该被过滤掉。
固定字段集合避免每次调用都临时拼装不同结构的日志，保证下游解析一致。
独立配置让同一条记录能在 console 详细、在 file 只留警戒线以上，互不牵连。
防止两个线程同时写导致同一行文件里混进另一条消息的字节，日志变成乱码。
optionExplanations_en: An ordered level enum is what makes per-destination threshold filtering possible in the first place.
A fixed field set keeps every log line parseable the same way instead of ad hoc per-call shapes.
Per-destination settings let the same record show up verbosely on console but sparsely in the file.
It stops two threads' writes from splicing together mid-line into unreadable garbled output.

q: 最合适的建模是什么？
q_en: What is the best model for this data?
options: 不可变 LogRecord 值对象
四个参数到处传
Destination 内部临时拼接全局变量
每个字段单独一个类
why: 这些字段总是一起出现、一起格式化，建成不可变记录能稳定方法签名。未来加 requestId 也只改记录结构。
why_en: LogRecord groups per-call data into one immutable value object that all destinations consume.
whenOtherWins: 非常小的脚本可直接传参数，但库设计中记录对象更稳。
tradeoff: 不可变值对象 vs 到处传递散装参数

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

options_en: An immutable LogRecord value object.
Pass the four fields around as loose parameters everywhere.
Have Destination stitch together global variables on the fly.
Give every field its own dedicated class.
optionExplanations: LogRecord 把四个字段打包成一份不可变快照，所有 destination 读同一份数据，未来加字段也只改这一个类。
把四个参数散着传，方法签名会随字段增长不断变化，调用点到处要改。
让 Destination 现拼字段等于把状态创建逻辑复制到每个目的地，容易各写各的、字段不一致。
每个字段单独建类只会增加对象数量，字段本就一起出现、一起格式化，没必要拆开。
optionExplanations_en: LogRecord bundles the four fields into one immutable snapshot that every destination reads, so adding a field later only touches this class.
Passing four loose parameters means every signature grows and every call site breaks whenever a field is added.
Having each Destination assemble its own state duplicates record-building logic and risks inconsistent fields across destinations.
Giving every field its own class just multiplies objects — the fields always travel and format together, so splitting them adds nothing.

q: LogRecord 字段为什么应只读？
q_en: Why should LogRecord fields be read-only?
options: 只读字段能让 CPU 缓存命中率更高，因此被误当作写入更快的必要条件
一条日志代表某时刻事实，destination/formatter 不应互相竞态修改它
Formatter 序列化时经常需要就地改写 message 字段以适配不同格式
threadName 应该在写入不同 destination 时重新捕获一次，才算准确
why: 不可变记录可安全地被多个 destination 和 formatter 读取。它也让格式化可以在锁外并行执行。
why_en: Immutable log records can be safely shared across destinations and formatted concurrently.
tradeoff: 不可变字段换并发安全 vs 可变字段换原地修改的灵活性

options_en: Read-only fields improve CPU cache hits, so they're mistaken for a write-speed requirement.
A log record represents a fact at one moment, and destinations/formatters must not race to mutate it.
A formatter needs to rewrite the message field in place to match different output formats.
ThreadName should be recaptured each time the record reaches a different destination.
optionExplanations: 缓存命中率是真实存在的次要好处，但把它当成不可变的理由本末倒置——真正原因是并发安全，不是性能。
抓住了要点——同一条记录本该是固定事实，谁都不该在旁路上改写它。
Formatter 不该就地改 message；它只应该读取字段生成一份新的格式化字符串。
重新捕获 threadName 会让同一次调用在不同 destination 看到不一致的线程名，破坏“同一事实”的前提。
optionExplanations_en: Cache locality is a real side effect, but citing it as the reason mistakes a minor perk for the actual concurrency motive.
Correctly names the reason: a record is a fixed fact, and no destination should be racing to rewrite it.
A formatter should never rewrite the message in place — it only reads fields to produce a new formatted string.
Recapturing threadName per destination would let the same call show different thread names, breaking the single-fact guarantee.

q: timestamp 和 threadName 应在哪里捕获？
q_en: Where should timestamp and threadName be captured?
options: 每个 Destination.write 内单独捕获
每个 Formatter.format 内捕获
Logger.log 顶部，只创建一次 LogRecord
FileSink.write 后捕获
why: 同一次 log 调用的所有目的地应看到同一条记录和同一时间点。放在 destination 内会造成同一记录不同时间戳。
why_en: Logger.log captures timestamp and thread name once so every destination sees the same record.
whenOtherWins: 如果目的地需要记录实际写入时间，可以额外加 emittedAt/writeTime，但不能替代事件时间。
tradeoff: 调用处一次性捕获 vs 每个 destination/formatter 各自捕获

termDefinitions.meaningEn: FileSink is a Sink implementation that opens a file handle once and appends formatted strings to it.

options_en: Capture separately inside each Destination.write.
Capture separately inside each Formatter.format.
Capture once at the top of Logger.log and build one LogRecord.
Capture only after FileSink.write finishes.

A formatter only serializes — putting capture there still lets each destination see a different timestamp.
Nails it: capture time and thread once at the call entry so every destination shares the exact same record.
Capturing after FileSink.write means the content is decided only after it's already written — the order is backwards.

q: 最终模型包含哪些核心类型？（多选）
q_en: Which core types are in the final model? (Select all)
options: Logger
LogRecord
Formatter
Destination
Sink
LogLevel
why: Logger 编排，LogRecord 携带数据，Formatter 序列化，Sink 输出字节，Destination 组合阈值/格式/输出并加锁。

options_en: Logger, the entry point.
LogRecord, the immutable data unit.

q_en: Why should Formatter be separate from Destination?
options: 格式和输出目标是两个独立变化轴，分离可避免 N×M 类爆炸
Formatter 需要自己持有并管理文件句柄
Destination 内部无法比较 LogLevel 大小
JSON 格式只能被写到 console 里
why: PlainText/JSON 可以配 Console/File/Remote 任意组合。把格式抽成策略，新增格式不改输出目标。
why_en: Formatter separates serialization from output target and prevents a format-by-destination class explosion.
tradeoff: 格式与输出目标独立变化 vs 耦合成 N×M 个类

termDefinitions.meaning: 标准错误输出流，常作为诊断信息的兜底通道，和正常业务输出分开。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Stderr, the standard error stream, is a common fallback channel for diagnostics kept separate from normal output.

options_en: Catch the exception, write a stderr diagnostic, and return without letting it escape to business code.
The exception from sink.write should bubble all the way up to the code that called logger.error.
One destination failing should immediately stop iterating over the remaining destinations.
A single sink failure should permanently disable every configured destination.
optionExplanations: 磁盘满时捕获异常、写 stderr 诊断再正常返回，业务代码完全不知道这次写失败了，但故障仍可被发现。
让异常冒泡意味着一次磁盘满就能让整条业务调用链崩溃，日志库不该有这个权力。
中止遍历会让 console 这类健康的 destination 也跟着收不到本该写的记录。
永久关闭所有目的地是把一次性磁盘故障放大成整个日志系统失效，代价过大。
optionExplanations_en: Catching the exception and logging a stderr diagnostic lets the write fail invisibly to the caller while the failure stays discoverable.
Letting the exception bubble up means a full disk can crash the entire business call chain — a logging library shouldn't have that power.
Aborting the loop means a healthy destination like console also misses records it should have received.
Permanently disabling every destination turns one transient disk failure into total logging outage — a wildly disproportionate response.

q: 完全吞掉 sink.write 异常的风险是什么？
q_en: What is the risk of swallowing sink.write exceptions completely?
options: 只要吞掉 sink 异常，业务代码就一定会崩溃退出
日志文件可能坏了几天没人发现
吞掉异常之后，出问题的那个 destination 会自动重试写入
吞掉写入异常会导致 LogRecord 里的 message 字段变成 null
why: 吞异常保护调用方，但没有可观测性。stderr 或状态 logger 是折中方案。
why_en: Swallowing sink failures silently can hide broken logging for a long time.
tradeoff: 吞异常保护调用方 vs 完全静默丢失可观测性

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已经格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

options_en: Swallowing the exception makes business code crash for sure.
The log file can silently stay broken for days before anyone notices.
The failing destination will automatically retry the write after the exception is swallowed.
Swallowing the write exception turns the record's message field into null.
optionExplanations: 吞掉异常恰恰是为了保护业务代码不崩溃，这个说法把因果关系说反了。
点中代价——吞得太干净反而失去可观测性，日志早就写不出去却没人知道。
吞掉异常只是不让它冒泡，不会触发任何自动重试逻辑，除非代码显式实现了它。
吞掉写入异常发生在 Sink 层面，跟已经创建好的 LogRecord 的字段值毫无关系。
optionExplanations_en: Swallowing the exception is precisely what keeps business code from crashing — this option has the causality backwards.
Names the real risk: swallowing too cleanly kills observability, so logging can be broken for days with nobody noticing.
Swallowing just stops the exception from propagating — it triggers no automatic retry unless that logic is explicitly written.
Swallowing a write exception happens at the Sink layer — it has no effect on a LogRecord's already-set field values.

q: Formatter 实现可以包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which Formatter implementations are valid? (Select all)
options: PlainTextFormatter
JsonFormatter
未来 CSV/key-value formatter
FileSink
why: Formatter 负责序列化 LogRecord。FileSink 是输出目标，不是格式。
why_en: Formatters serialize records, while sinks write formatted strings to targets.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成一行人类可读文本，如 timestamp [level] [thread] message。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PlainTextFormatter serializes a LogRecord into one human-readable line of text.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成 JSON 字符串，字段名对应 timestamp/level/thread/message。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: JsonFormatter serializes a LogRecord into a JSON string with timestamp, level, thread, and message fields.

termDefinitions.meaning: Sink 的一个实现，构造时打开并复用一个文件句柄，把格式化字符串追加写入文件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FileSink is a Sink implementation that opens a file handle once and appends formatted strings to it.

options_en: PlainTextFormatter.
JsonFormatter.
A future CSV or key-value formatter.
FileSink.
optionExplanations: 把记录序列化成人类可读的一行文本，方便本地调试直接看。
把记录序列化成结构化 JSON，方便下游工具解析和检索。
属于同一个变化轴——只是换一种序列化格式，不涉及输出目标。
FileSink 是输出目标的实现，负责把字符串写到文件，不做任何序列化工作。
optionExplanations_en: Serializes a record into one human-readable text line, handy for reading logs directly during debugging.
Serializes a record into structured JSON so downstream tooling can parse and search it.
Sits on the same axis as the others — just another serialization shape, with no opinion about the output target.
FileSink is an output target implementation that writes strings to a file — it does no serialization at all.

scenario: FileSink 每次写日志都要输出到同一个文件。
scenario_en: FileSink writes every log line to the same file.
q: 文件句柄应如何管理？
q_en: How should the file handle be managed?
options: 每写一条日志就重新 open 一次文件，写完立刻 close
让 Formatter 在 format() 方法内部负责打开目标文件
构造时打开并复用 append writer
把目标文件的全部历史内容缓存进每一个 LogRecord 对象里
why: 每次 open syscall 成本高且没有必要。FileSink 拥有文件 writer，Destination 负责同步调用。
why_en: FileSink should open the file once and append through a reused writer.
whenOtherWins: 如果写入目标是短生命周期临时文件，可以每次打开，但普通 logger 不应这样做。
tradeoff: 构造时打开一次复用 vs 每次调用都 open/close

termDefinitions.meaning: Sink 的一个实现，构造时打开并复用一个文件句柄，把格式化字符串追加写入文件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FileSink is a Sink implementation that opens a file handle once and appends formatted strings to it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

options_en: Every log call should reopen and close the file.
Formatter.format should be the one opening the target file.
Open the file once in the constructor and reuse an append writer.
The file's entire history should be cached inside every LogRecord.
optionExplanations: 每条日志都 open/close 一次意味着每次写日志都多付一次系统调用成本，写得越频繁越贵。
打开文件是资源生命周期管理，属于 Sink 该做的事；Formatter 只管把记录变成字符串。
构造时开一次文件、之后一直复用同一个 writer 追加写入，省掉重复 open 的系统调用开销。
把整个文件历史塞进每个 LogRecord 会让每条记录都携带越来越大的历史包袱，完全偏离了它的职责。
optionExplanations_en: Reopening and closing per log line means paying a syscall cost on every single write — the more you log, the more it costs.
Opening a file is a resource-management job that belongs to Sink — Formatter's job is only turning a record into a string.
Open the file once in the constructor and keep reusing the same append writer, avoiding repeated open syscalls.
Caching the whole file history inside every LogRecord makes each record drag along a growing history blob — nowhere near its job.

scenario: 进程崩溃前最后几条日志可能仍在缓冲区。
scenario_en: The last few log lines may still be buffered when the process crashes.
q: 真实 FileSink 通常还要考虑什么？
q_en: What else should a real FileSink consider?
options: 每写一条日志之前先把整个文件删除重建
文件句柄打开后永远不主动关闭，交给操作系统兜底
把 flush() 调用放进 Formatter.format 方法里执行
按每条或有界间隔 flush
why: 只在 close 时 flush 对 logger 不理想，因为崩溃时可能看不到最近日志。flush 策略是可靠性和性能的权衡。
why_en: A real file sink needs a flush strategy so recent logs are visible before a crash.
whenOtherWins: 高吞吐系统可能批量 flush，降低 I/O 成本但接受小窗口数据丢失。
tradeoff: 更及时的 flush 换崩溃前可见 vs 只在 close 时 flush 换更少 I/O

termDefinitions.meaning: Sink 的一个实现，构造时打开并复用一个文件句柄，把格式化字符串追加写入文件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: FileSink is a Sink implementation that opens a file handle once and appends formatted strings to it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

options_en: The file should be deleted and recreated before every write.
The file handle should never be explicitly closed and left to the OS.
Flush() belongs inside Formatter.format instead of the sink.
Flush after every record, or after a bounded interval.
optionExplanations: 每次写入前删除重建文件会直接抹掉之前所有日志，这是数据丢失，不是 flush 策略。
从不主动关闭句柄会让缓冲区里的最后几条日志在进程崩溃时永远留在内存里，看不到。
flush 是针对已写入的字节做落盘，Formatter 那一步字符串还没写进 sink，放错了阶段。
按每条或每隔一定条数 flush，是在“崩溃前能看到多少日志”和“I/O 开销多大”之间选一个平衡点。
optionExplanations_en: Deleting and recreating the file before every write erases all prior logs — that's data loss, not a flush policy.
Never closing the handle leaves whatever's still buffered stuck in memory forever if the process crashes.
Flush operates on bytes already handed to the sink — Formatter runs before that, so it's the wrong stage entirely.
Flushing per record or at a bounded interval trades off how much you'd lose on a crash against how much I/O overhead you accept.

q: 为什么 Logger 不在全局层面按 level 过滤？
q_en: Why should Logger not filter by level globally?
options: 每个 destination 有自己的 minLevel，同一 record 可能写 console 但不写 file
把过滤放在 Logger 全局这一层统一执行，反而比每个 destination 各自过滤更加安全更省事更可靠
因为 Logger.log 这个方法本身完全没有设计 level 参数可供全局过滤使用
因为 Destination 内部其实无法对 LogLevel 这个枚举值做大小比较判断的缘故
why: 阈值是 destination 的配置。全局过滤会错误丢掉某些目的地本应接收的记录。
why_en: Threshold filtering belongs to Destination because each destination has its own minimum level.
tradeoff: 阈值下放到每个 destination vs 阈值收在 Logger 全局层

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每个 destination 自己配置的最低级别阈值，记录级别低于它就被静默丢弃。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: minLevel is the per-destination threshold below which a record is silently dropped.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日志库的唯一入口类，持有不可变 destinations 列表，把每次调用打包成 LogRecord 并 fan-out 给每个 destination。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Logger is the single entry point that builds one LogRecord per call and fans it out to every configured destination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 五值有序枚举 DEBUG<INFO<WARN<ERROR<FATAL，用于记录严重度和 destination 的阈值比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LogLevel is the five-value ordered enum from DEBUG to FATAL used for severity and threshold comparisons.

options_en: Each destination keeps its own minLevel, so the same record can reach console but get dropped at file.
Filtering globally in one place on Logger is actually safer and simpler than per-destination filtering.
Logger.log's method signature was never designed with a level parameter for global filtering.
Destination is internally unable to compare LogLevel enum values against each other at all.
optionExplanations: 抓住关键——阈值是每个 destination 自己的配置，同一条记录完全可能一个目的地收、另一个目的地丢。
全局过滤反而更危险——它会在 Logger 层就先丢掉记录，某些本该收到低级别日志的 destination 永远看不到。
Logger.log 明明是接收 level 参数的，问题不在缺参数，而在过滤逻辑该放哪一层。
LogLevel 是有序枚举，Destination 完全可以直接比较大小，这不是限制所在。
optionExplanations_en: Gets the key point: threshold is per-destination config, so the same record can land at one destination and get dropped at another.
Global filtering is actually riskier — it drops records at the Logger level before some destinations that wanted them ever see them.
Logger.log does take a level parameter — the issue isn't a missing argument, it's which layer should filter.
LogLevel is an ordered enum that Destination can compare directly — that's not the constraint here.

q: 以下每项 v1 排除的功能，为什么之后能在不改核心模型的情况下加上？（多选）
q_en: Why can each excluded v1 feature be added later without changing the core model? (Select all)
options: 异步/缓冲写
运行时热加载配置
远程/网络目的地
层级命名 logger
why: 这四项都被设计成能在不触碰 Logger 核心 API 的前提下叠加：异步和远程都落在已有的 Sink/queue 接口上，热更新只需换存储方式，层级只需加一层注册表。
why_en: Each excluded feature slots into an existing extension point — a Sink implementation, a swappable reference, or a factory registry — without rewriting Logger's core API.
scenario: Logger 的 v1 只实现同步、单机、静态配置的核心模型，把异步写、热更新配置、远程目的地、层级 logger 都排在范围外。
scenario_en: Logger v1 implements only the synchronous, single-machine, static-configuration core; async writes, hot config reload, remote destinations, and hierarchical loggers are out of scope.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Logger is the single entry point that builds one LogRecord per call and fans it out to every configured destination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 假想中的未来 Sink 实现，把格式化字符串通过网络写到远程日志端点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RemoteSink is a hypothetical future Sink implementation that writes formatted strings to a remote endpoint.

termDefinitions.meaning: 层级 logger 的全局注册表，按 dotted-name 返回同一个 Logger 实例并挂上 parent 指针。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LoggerFactory is the global registry for hierarchical loggers that returns the same instance per dotted name and links it to its parent.

options_en: Async writes — add a bounded queue and worker to Destination, Logger stays untouched.
Hot-reload config — swap destinations for an atomically replaceable reference, the caller API stays the same.
Remote destinations — add a new RemoteSink implementing Sink, the interface doesn't change.
Hierarchical loggers — add name/parent fields to Logger and a LoggerFactory registry.
optionExplanations: 落在给 Destination 加 queue+worker 上，Logger 的 API 完全不用动。
只需把 destinations 换成可原子替换的引用，调用方接口不变。
只是新增一个实现 Sink 接口的 RemoteSink，接口本身不改。
需要给 Logger 加 name/parent 字段和一个工厂注册表，是唯一会新增字段的一项。
optionExplanations_en: Slots into adding a queue and worker to Destination — Logger's API doesn't move at all.
Only needs destinations swapped for an atomically replaceable reference — the caller-facing API stays the same.
Just means adding a new RemoteSink that implements the existing Sink interface — the interface itself doesn't change.
Needs name/parent fields on Logger plus a factory registry — the one extension that actually adds fields.

scenario: log() 不能被慢文件或网络写阻塞。
scenario_en: log() must not be blocked by a slow file or network write.
q: 最自然的非阻塞扩展是什么？
q_en: What is the most natural non-blocking extension?
options: 每次调用 log() 都新建一个专属的独立线程，负责把这条记录写到所有已经配置好的目的地上
每个 Destination 一个 bounded BlockingQueue 和 worker thread
直接去掉 destination 自己持有的那把锁，让多个线程并发调用 sink.write 执行写入
把 Formatter.format 这个方法本身也改造成异步非阻塞的具体实现方式
why: 调用方只入队，单 consumer worker 串行写 sink，天然保持 destination 内顺序并可去掉该 sink 锁。bounded queue 还能定义背压策略。
why_en: A bounded queue and worker per destination make log calls mostly enqueue operations while one consumer writes the sink.
whenOtherWins: 同步 v1 更简单；只有调用延迟成为要求时才引入队列和 worker 生命周期。
diagram:
flowchart TD
A["caller log()"] --> B["Destination filter"]
B --> C["bounded queue"]
C --> D["worker thread"]
D --> E["format record"]
E --> F["sink.write"]
G["shutdown"] --> H["drain queue and join worker"]
tradeoff: 每目标一条 bounded queue + 单 worker vs 每次调用都开线程

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程安全的有界队列，满时可以阻塞、丢弃或拒绝生产者，常用于单消费者 worker 场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A BlockingQueue is a thread-safe bounded queue that can block, drop, or reject producers when full, often paired with a single consumer worker.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把 LogRecord 序列化成字符串的策略接口，PlainText 和 JSON 是两个实现，和输出目标无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Formatter is a strategy interface that serializes a LogRecord into a string, independent of the output target.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已经格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

options_en: Spawning a brand-new dedicated thread per log call to write to every configured destination.
A bounded BlockingQueue and a dedicated worker thread per Destination.
Removing the lock a destination holds and just writing concurrently from multiple threads instead.
Making Formatter.format itself into an asynchronous, non-blocking implementation.
optionExplanations: 每次调用都开新线程，日志量一高线程数量会失控增长，反而拖垮系统。
每个目的地配一条有界队列和单独 worker，调用方只管入队立刻返回，写入交给后台线程串行处理。
去掉锁又让多个线程并发写同一个 sink，字节交错的问题会原样重现。
Formatter 本身是纯函数，不涉及 I/O，把它改造成异步没有实际收益，真正的阻塞点在 sink 写入。
optionExplanations_en: Spawning a thread per call means thread count explodes under load — the "fix" becomes the new bottleneck.
One bounded queue and worker per destination means the caller just enqueues and returns while a background thread handles the write serially.
Removing the lock while letting multiple threads write the same sink concurrently just brings back the interleaved-bytes problem.
Formatter is already a pure function with no I/O — making it async buys nothing, since the real blocking happens at the sink write.

q: 异步 Destination 需要额外考虑哪些问题？（多选）
q_en: What extra issues does an async Destination need to handle? (Select all)
options: worker 生命周期和 shutdown drain
queue 满时的 overflow policy
写失败在 worker 线程上的诊断
是否批量写和 flush
why: 异步不是只加一个队列。它把写入时机移到后台，带来关闭、丢弃、背压和可观测性问题。
why_en: Async logging adds worker lifecycle, overflow, diagnostics, batching, and flushing decisions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线程安全的有界队列，满时可以阻塞、丢弃或拒绝生产者，常用于单消费者 worker 场景。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A BlockingQueue is a thread-safe bounded queue that can block, drop, or reject producers when full, often paired with a single consumer worker.

options_en: Worker lifecycle and shutdown drain.
The queue's overflow policy when it's full.
Diagnosing write failures that happen on the worker thread.
Whether to batch writes and how to flush them.
optionExplanations: 没处理好 shutdown 会让缓冲区里还没写出的日志在进程退出时直接丢失。
queue 满时不定策略，调用方要么被无限阻塞，要么记录被悄悄丢弃，两种都得明确选。
写失败现在发生在 worker 线程上，调用方彻底看不到，必须单独安排诊断出口。
批量和 flush 决定了崩溃时最多丢多少条日志，是可靠性和吞吐之间的又一个旋钮。

scenario_en: Someone wants Logger to expose addDestination, removeDestination, and reloadConfig.
q: 基础需求下应该怎么做？
q_en: What should you do for the base requirements?
options: 把 addDestination、removeDestination、reloadConfig 全部实现出来以显示功能完整
把 addDestination 这类配置方法直接定义在 LogRecord 类上
不暴露；配置启动时固定，保持 destinations immutable
让 Sink 接口反过来持有并修改 Logger 的配置状态
why: YAGNI：热更新明确 out of scope。不可变配置简化并发遍历和 API。
why_en: Since configuration is fixed at startup, keeping destinations immutable avoids unnecessary concurrency complexity.
whenOtherWins: 如果需求加入热更新，可用原子替换 destination 列表或配置管理器。
tradeoff: YAGNI 保持不可变 vs 提前实现热更新换灵活性

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个已配置的输出目标，组合 minLevel、Formatter 和 Sink，负责过滤、格式化、加锁写入的完整流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Destination is one configured output target that composes a threshold, a formatter, and a sink to filter, format, and write under a lock.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次 log 调用生成的不可变值对象，携带 timestamp、level、message、threadName 四个字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A LogRecord is the immutable value object created per log call, carrying timestamp, level, message, and thread name.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只负责把已经格式化好的字符串写到具体目标（stdout、文件、未来的网络）的窄接口，不做过滤或格式化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A Sink is a narrow interface that only writes an already formatted string to a target like stdout, a file, or the network.

termDefinitions.meaning: 日志库的唯一入口类，持有不可变 destinations 列表，把每次调用打包成 LogRecord 并 fan-out 给每个 destination。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Logger is the single entry point that builds one LogRecord per call and fans it out to every configured destination.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种工程原则：不要为当下还不需要的功能预先建设复杂度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: YAGNI, short for You Aren't Gonna Need It, argues against building complexity for a requirement you don't have yet.

options_en: Implementing all three methods shows completeness.
AddDestination-style methods belong on LogRecord.
Don't expose them; configuration is fixed at startup and destinations stay immutable.
Sink should hold and mutate Logger's configuration.
optionExplanations: 全部实现出来会带来热更新的并发复杂度，而这正是需求明确排除在范围外的东西。
配置方法管的是 Logger 的目的地列表，跟 LogRecord 这个一次性数据快照毫不相干。
需求已经明说热更新不在范围内，配置在启动时钉死、destinations 保持不可变，API 和并发遍历都更简单。
让 Sink 反过来持有并修改 Logger 配置会把依赖方向倒转，输出接口不该管理它的调用方。
optionExplanations_en: Implementing all three brings in hot-reload's concurrency complexity — exactly what the requirements explicitly ruled out.
Configuration methods manage Logger's destination list — completely unrelated to LogRecord, a one-shot data snapshot.
The requirements already rule out hot-reload, so locking configuration at startup keeps both the API and concurrent iteration simpler.
Having Sink hold and mutate Logger's config inverts the dependency direction — an output interface shouldn't manage its caller.
